Mikey you are really fortunated to come across RTM at so early stage of your jorney. I am jealous at you

RBD DBR and flag limits work as supply and demand. When price hit RBD(supply) you expect it to drop to the next demand which may be flag limit or DBR. When price hit DBR(demand) you expect it to go up to the next supply which may be flag limit or RBD.
